description: Image-grounded flat-eraser tabletop wipe eval: the current ToolFrame wood-table scene, a visible raised white tabletop HDU board with stratified seeded pose/yaw variation, fixed near-hand eraser start pose shared by VLM render and rollout, generic VLM scene-ref grounding from public multi-view RGB-D evidence, task-conditioned P3SAM/VLM flat-eraser tool refs, whole-tool SE(3) fixed-goal rollout, and eraser-specific semantic contact/path success.

scene_initialization.start_pose_policy: runtime mesh-table-contact projection keeps the shared fixed front-of-arm flat_eraser mesh on the tabletop with 3 mm clearance; xy and yaw do not vary by seed.

target.physical_role: fixed raised white tabletop board containing the HDU text; the board top is the physical contact surface

seed_variation_policy.description: Each seed deterministically spreads the single-asset raised white HDU tabletop board over a 5x4 table-safe grid across both table halves; the eraser start pose remains fixed in front of the robot hand and is shared by the VLM render, compile scaffold, and rollout.

scene_initialization.target_grounding_policy: The shared VLM scene-ref interface applies: natural task language and public top-down RGB-D evidence provide start_point, optional path_points, explicit end_point, and scene.direction when applicable. Evaluator-side coverage checks remain in the task contract.
scene_initialization.tool_grounding_policy: Use task-conditioned P3SAM/VLM flat_eraser refs: VLM selects the contact-point part from segmented parts, then selects the contact point marker and the tool motion-axis marker from evidence for that selected part.
scene_initialization.trajectory_policy: Reset/start-pose scaffold for SimToolReal initialization only; not a method input, target trajectory, oracle trajectory, or success template.

mainline_params.table_clearance_rule: all tool-part OBB corners must stay above the table/mark contact surface

acceptance.success_policy: eraser_wipe_contact_coverage: a seed succeeds when the diagnostic path gate passes, lifted start/end refs lie on the visible target board surface, and rollout samples show the flat-eraser bottom contact footprint covering at least 30% of the visible tabletop HDU board long-axis extent. Policy-goal/semantic execution/tracking pass and visual HDU disappearance are diagnostic only.

tool_grounding_contract.notes: Human-reviewed eraser contract: contact-point part marker 4; wiping contact uses the non-internal faces among F3/F4; all other non-internal faces may serve as motion-axis refs.

per_seed_checks: VLM overlay is present on the tabletop scene
lifted refs record the visible tabletop HDU board and a full-length wipe motion axis starting near the eraser-side edge
constraint program aligns `tool.motion_axis` to the wipe motion axis before contact and during wiping
constraint program uses public flat_eraser tool refs from the two-stage P3SAM/VLM grounding
fixed goals compile without hidden evaluator target refs
rollout video and rollout_summary are written when rollout is enabled

contract_status.notes: Semantic contact-path success is reviewed; strict coverage and visual disappearance are diagnostic.
